caption: The owner/model-name string is what from_pretrained needs.

code:
from transformers import AutoTokenizer, AutoModel

tokenizer = AutoTokenizer.from_pretrained(
    "bert-base-uncased")
model = AutoModel.from_pretrained(
    "bert-base-uncased")
caption: Auto classes pick the right architecture automatically.
config.json, the weights, the tokenizer files — nothing more.

code:
inputs = tokenizer("Hugging Face is based in NY.",
                    return_tensors="pt")
outputs = model(**inputs)

outputs.last_hidden_state.shape
